packs.author: DeathWrench
packs.licence: Not stated; fan-made, credit the author

packs.title: Pokemon X / Pokemon Y
packs.author: Ullr8, Gray-Rice
packs.licence: Not stated; fan-made, credit the authors
packs.notes: Work in progress. Based on Pokemon Y Resurrection.

packs.name: Pokemon Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon HD
packs.title: Pokemon Ultra Sun / Pokemon Ultra Moon
packs.author: Volya, Gray-Rice
packs.licence: Not stated; fan-made, credit the authors
packs.notes: Textures from the Citra forum archive.

packs.name: Ocarina of Time 3D 4K
packs.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 3D
packs.author: Henriko Magnifico
packs.licence: Not stated; free for emulators, credit the author
packs.notes: Textures only; the pack's ReShade files are not used. Version 5.0a. Size not confirmed (Google Drive was over its download limit when checked).

packs.author: Henriko Magnifico
packs.licence: Not stated; free for emulators, credit the author

packs.title: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask 3D
packs.author: Henriko Magnifico
packs.licence: Not stated; free for emulators, credit the author

packs.name: Majora's Mask 3D 1080p
packs.title: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask 3D
packs.author: Henriko Magnifico
packs.licence: Not stated; free for emulators, credit the author
packs.notes: Textures only; the pack's ReShade files are not used. Version 3.0b, for 1080p screens. USA and Europe only.

packs.name: Super Mario 3D Land 4K
packs.title: Super Mario 3D Land
packs.author: Henriko Magnifico
packs.licence: Not stated; free for emulators, credit the author
packs.notes: Textures only; the pack's ReShade files are not used. Version 1.2.0b.

packs.title: Super Mario 3D Land
packs.author: Henriko Magnifico
packs.licence: Not stated; free for emulators, credit the author
packs.notes: Textures only; the pack's ReShade files are not used. Version 1.2.0b, for 1080p screens.

packs.title: The Legend of Zelda: A Link Between Worlds
packs.author: Henriko Magnifico
packs.licence: Not stated; free for emulators, credit the author
packs.notes: Textures only; the pack's ReShade files are not used. Version 2.0b. USA only (the pack is made for the USA game).

packs.name: A Link Between Worlds 1080p
packs.title: The Legend of Zelda: A Link Between Worlds
packs.author: Henriko Magnifico
packs.licence: Not stated; free for emulators, credit the author
packs.notes: Textures only; the pack's ReShade files are not used. Version 2.0b, for 1080p screens. USA only.

packs.name: SSE Controller UI (Xbox)
packs.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 3D
packs.author: chubbycubby
packs.notes: Rearranges the button prompts of the Single Screen Experience into the Xbox controller layout, as 4K textures for the USA version. It needs Single Screen Experience and Henriko's Ocarina of Time 3D 4K texture pack, and the buttons must be remapped as the mod page describes. The download is about 450 MB, and the pack's one message file (sys8.qbf) is not installed.

packs.name: SSE Controller UI (Switch)
packs.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 3D
packs.author: chubbycubby
packs.notes: Rearranges the button prompts of the Single Screen Experience into the Switch controller layout, as 4K textures for the USA version. It needs Single Screen Experience and Henriko's Ocarina of Time 3D 4K texture pack, and the buttons must be remapped as the mod page describes. The download is about 450 MB, and the pack's one message file (sys8.qbf) is not installed.

packs.name: SSE Controller UI (Vanilla)
packs.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 3D
packs.author: chubbycubby
packs.notes: Rearranges the button prompts of the Single Screen Experience into the Vanilla controller layout, as 4K textures for the USA version. It needs Single Screen Experience and Henriko's Ocarina of Time 3D 4K texture pack, and the buttons must be remapped as the mod page describes. The download is about 450 MB, and the pack's one message file (sys8.qbf) is not installed.

packs.name: Link Skin Pack
packs.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 3D
packs.author: Art-Does-Not-Compute
packs.notes: Several looks for Link as textures for the USA version, each shown as its own pack. Base is the main set and the others replace part of it, and the Legacy textures pack mixes several older styles. It was made for Citra and has not been tested here.

packs.name: Touchless Layout UI
packs.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 3D
packs.author: HardDanX
packs.notes: Redraws the button prompts for Xbox, DualShock, Nintendo or SNES-colour controllers so the touch screen is not needed, for the original UI. Each layout is its own pack, and the one named Unedited textures is the stock reference set, not a layout. It needs the controller remapping and the sensor map described on the mod page.

packs.name: Touchless Layout UI (Single Screen Experience)
packs.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 3D
packs.author: HardDanX
packs.notes: The same controller layouts for Single Screen Experience, which must be installed first, for the USA and Europe versions. Each layout is its own pack, and the one named Unedited textures is the stock reference set. The author calls this version severely outdated.

packs.name: 1998 NPC Overhaul
packs.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 3D
packs.author: HugAMuffin
packs.notes: Redraws the textures of the main NPCs to look closer to the 1998 official art, sorted into folders by character. The page does not name a region and the textures are not in a region folder, so Japan is left out. The author recommends it together with Better Remaster Experience.

packs.name: Expressive Face Textures for Link
packs.title: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask 3D
packs.author: LochNessHamster
packs.notes: High-resolution face textures that make Link more expressive, for the USA version. The tunic recolour in the screenshots is part of the Majora's Mask 3D HD project and is not included.

packs.name: Travelers Clothes
packs.title: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask 3D
packs.author: Broglerd
packs.notes: Gives Link a traveller's outfit as textures for the USA version, built on the Expressive Face Textures for Link mod. Other texture packs for Link's face and clothes cannot be used with it at the same time.

packs.name: Project Restoration UI
packs.title: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask 3D
packs.author: HugAMuffin
packs.notes: Adds prompts for the controls that Project Restoration introduces, such as swim speed, arrow swapping and the song screen, with an Xbox One layout. It needs Project Restoration, was made for Citra, and the new prompts are small on a shrunk touch screen.

packs.name: Omni UI for Project Restoration
packs.title: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask 3D
packs.author: HardDanX
packs.notes: Controller prompts for Project Restoration in Xbox, DualShock, Nintendo or SNES-colour styles, for the USA and Europe versions. It needs Project Restoration and the controller remapping in the ReadMe, and each style is its own pack. Ignore the Unedited textures pack, and the N64 Patch pack only holds changed files for the Xbox or DualShock style.

packs.name: Non-Intrusive Bottom Screen HUD
packs.title: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask 3D
packs.author: vladone97
packs.notes: Removes most of the bottom screen's graphics so both screens can be laid over one display, with the lower one set to about 20% transparency. It was made for the Europe version, and the author has not tested the others. Non-paused maps are not removed.

packs.name: DQ8 HD Texture Pack (4x Full)
packs.title: Dragon Quest VIII: Journey of the Cursed King
packs.author: Magic Banana
packs.notes: The full 4x pack, version 1.1.0, with every texture and the UI, hosted by the author on Google Drive. It is large, about 6.4 GB, and preloading it takes around 20 GB of RAM, so on the Frame it streams in instead of preloading. It was made on the Europe version and works on the USA one.

packs.name: DQ8 HD Texture Pack (2x Full)
packs.title: Dragon Quest VIII: Journey of the Cursed King
packs.author: Magic Banana
packs.notes: The full 2x pack, version 1.1.0, with every texture and the UI, hosted by the author on Google Drive. About 1.8 GB, and preloading it takes around 5 GB of RAM. The 4x UI pack on top keeps the menus sharp. It was made on the Europe version and works on the USA one.

packs.name: DQ8 HD Texture Pack (4x UI)
packs.title: Dragon Quest VIII: Journey of the Cursed King
packs.author: Magic Banana
packs.notes: The UI, item and equipment icons, character portraits and map icons of the 4x HD pack, which is more than the name says. The full pack is hosted by the author on Google Drive and is not included here. It was made on the Europe version and works on the USA one, and preloading it adds under 1 GB of RAM.

packs.name: DQ8 HD Texture Pack (4x Restoration)
packs.title: Dragon Quest VIII: Journey of the Cursed King
packs.author: Magic Banana
packs.notes: 4x textures for the changes made by the Restoration Mod (party characters and armor), which do not need that mod installed. It is an add-on to the full HD pack, which the author hosts on Google Drive, so on its own it changes little. It was made on the Europe version and works on the USA one.

packs.name: DQ8 HD Texture Pack (2x Restoration)
packs.title: Dragon Quest VIII: Journey of the Cursed King
packs.author: Magic Banana
packs.notes: 2x textures for the changes made by the Restoration Mod (party characters and armor), which do not need that mod installed. It is an add-on to the full 2x HD pack, which the author hosts on Google Drive, so on its own it changes little. It was made on the Europe version and works on the USA one.

packs.name: SM3DL HD UI Pack
packs.title: Super Mario 3D Land
packs.author: GalacticMoblin
packs.notes: Hand-redrawn HD versions of the game's UI art, made for Citra and Azahar. It is a partial pack that replaces only the UI textures; turn on Custom Textures and Preload Custom Textures.

packs.name: 5X Redrawn UI HD
packs.title: Pokemon X / Pokemon Y
packs.author: blivveries
packs.notes: Hand-redrawn and 5x-upscaled HUD, menus, fonts, type icons and Pokemon sprites for the USA, Europe and Japan versions, as custom textures only. The author tested it with Vulkan at 5x resolution and says any Texture Filter option must be turned off or the game can crash.

packs.name: Modern Pokemon Sprites
packs.title: Pokemon X / Pokemon Y
packs.author: stingflyer
packs.notes: Replaces every Pokemon sprite, including forms and Megas, with modern artwork from the later games. The author tested it on Azahar only and warns that texture filters must be off.

packs.name: Clean Pokedex Background
packs.title: Pokemon X / Pokemon Y
packs.author: stingflyer
packs.notes: A bonus file from the Modern Pokemon Sprites mod: a transparent texture that removes the dotted background of the Pokedex. It is one texture, so it is the same on every region.

packs.name: Emerald Brendan (Textures)
packs.title: Pokemon Omega Ruby / Pokemon Alpha Sapphire
packs.author: Remontafb
packs.notes: Reskins Brendan with his Emerald look as custom textures; the original design is by Dionn Runk and credited on the page. Remove any Brendan model mod first or the model shows instead. The file is named for Alpha Sapphire, and Omega Ruby is untested.

packs.name: Modern Pokemon Sprites
packs.title: Pokemon Omega Ruby / Pokemon Alpha Sapphire
packs.author: stingflyer
packs.notes: Replaces the sprites of every Pokemon, including forms and Megas, with modern artwork at 8x resolution; Cosplay Pikachu is not included. The author tested it on Azahar only and has not tried a console.

packs.name: 5X Redrawn UI (Incomplete Port)
packs.title: Pokemon Omega Ruby / Pokemon Alpha Sapphire
packs.author: stingflyer
packs.notes: An unfinished port of the 5X Redrawn UI textures from X and Y to Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire, at 8x resolution. Only the parts that carried over work, so some of the HUD stays at the original resolution. The author tested it on Azahar only.

packs.name: Ghibli Style Textures
packs.title: Pokemon Omega Ruby / Pokemon Alpha Sapphire
packs.author: Pandaa shiverian
packs.notes: Gives the game a Studio Ghibli look inspired by Howl's Moving Castle; the first three towns are nearly done and it is still in progress. It is made for the European version and all languages except Japanese and Korean, and the author cannot promise it works on the USA version. The notes are in Spanish.

packs.name: Bravely Default HD Texture Pack
packs.title: Bravely Default
packs.author: microturing
packs.notes: A full HD texture pack by 1vierock, reuploaded by microturing as one large RAR, made for Citra-style custom textures. The download is about 1 GB, and the system bsdtar cannot open the file (unsupported RAR dictionary size), so its layout could not be checked.

packs.name: HD Font and Icons
packs.title: Bravely Default
packs.author: Zominion
packs.notes: Redrawn font, numbers, job icons and simple icons for Bravely Default, hand-drawn rather than upscaled. The author calls it an unfinished release, and it has older patch folders inside that overlap the newer files.

packs.name: HD Font and Icons
packs.title: Bravely Second: End Layer
packs.author: Zominion
packs.notes: Redrawn font, numbers and simple icons for Bravely Second, adapted from the Bravely Default set. The author could not fully test it and calls it an unfinished release.

packs.name: HD Skill Icons
packs.title: Persona Q2: New Cinema Labyrinth
packs.author: Century_
packs.notes: Redraws every skill icon at 4x resolution as one custom texture for the USA version. It replaces the same texture as the P5 Skill Icons pack, so use only one of them.

packs.name: P5 Skill Icons (HD)
packs.title: Persona Q2: New Cinema Labyrinth
packs.author: rabbitgirlkris
packs.notes: Redraws the battle skill icons in the Persona 5 style as a single HD texture, for use with the HD icon pack. It replaces the same texture as the HD Skill Icons pack. The page lists no region, so the USA folder is assumed; the base-resolution version needs a PC tool and is not included.

packs.name: Kirby Triple Deluxe HD
packs.title: Kirby: Triple Deluxe
packs.author: ShadowThenHedHog
packs.notes: An HD texture pack that upscales most of the in-game textures, including maps, stickers and the UI, for the USA version. The download is about 808 MB. It is texture-only.

packs.name: Mario's Mansion
packs.title: Luigi's Mansion: Dark Moon
packs.author: Zelda mystery
packs.notes: Lets you play as Mario in Dark Moon by replacing Luigi's textures; it is texture-only, with just a few files. The page does not say which regions it was made for, so other versions are untested.

packs.name: Mario's Mansion HD
packs.title: Luigi's Mansion: Dark Moon
packs.author: Zelda mystery
packs.notes: A higher-resolution version of the Mario's Mansion textures, about 1,750 files, which also replaces many other Dark Moon textures. The download is about 223 MB. The page does not say which regions it was made for, so other versions are untested.

packs.name: Playable Gooigi
packs.title: Luigi's Mansion: Dark Moon
packs.author: MugginOven
packs.notes: Retextures the player so you play as Gooigi, as 48 custom textures only. The page shows only a short readme and no region, so other versions than the one the author used are untested.

packs.name: 4x Texture Pack
packs.title: Mario & Luigi: Paper Jam
packs.author: zillaHD
packs.notes: A 4x upscale of the game textures by zillaHD, mixing hand-redrawn UI and text with AI upscaling, which turns the character pixel art into smoother 3D-looking art. The download is about 1.4 GB, and GameBanana has not finished scanning it. It is made for the USA version.

packs.name: 4x PixelArt+ Texture Pack
packs.title: Mario & Luigi: Paper Jam
packs.author: zillaHD
packs.notes: The alternate version of the 4x texture pack that keeps and sharpens the character pixel art instead of converting it to 3D. The download is about 1 GB. It is made for the USA version, and it replaces the same textures as the other 4x pack.

packs.name: Wario Long Sleeves
packs.title: Mario Party: The Top 100
packs.author: Metal-Mario-Fan
packs.notes: Retextures Wario's arms as long sleeves, like his classic look, with 58 replacement textures. It is made for the North American version, and the folder inside is named for that game's title ID. Turn on Custom Textures and Preload Custom Textures.

packs.name: Radiant Historia HD
packs.title: Radiant Historia: Perfect Chronology
packs.author: Serbagz
packs.notes: A 4x upscale of the UI, fonts, CGs, character art and world and battle textures, with the official HD CGs used where they exist. The chibi art is still unfinished. It is a 727 MB RAR for the North American version, and its bonus-content archives are not installed. Turn on Custom Textures and Preload Custom Textures.

packs.name: TOA GenEi LateGo v2 (Font and UI)
packs.title: Tales of the Abyss 3D
packs.author: rikimtasu
packs.licence: Not stated; fan-made, credit the author
packs.notes: Replaces the game's font and UI textures with a sharper GenEi LateGo Japanese-Latin font. It is made for the North American version only. The zip is committed to the author's repository rather than published as a release, so it is downloaded from there.

packs.name: Etrian Odyssey Nexus HD Portraits (v3)
packs.title: Etrian Odyssey Nexus
packs.author: rikimtasu
packs.notes: AI-upscaled 4x character portraits, covering most player and a few NPC textures, in the lighter AnimeSharp version. It was made for the European game and the author says it also works on the North American one. The page is titled Etrian Odyssey Nexus, not Untold; it is 754 MB, and the HD Texts pack is a separate entry.

packs.name: Etrian Odyssey Nexus HD Texts
packs.title: Etrian Odyssey Nexus
packs.author: rikimtasu
packs.notes: AI-upscaled text and font textures, a small companion to the HD Portraits pack. It was made for the European game and the author says it also works on the North American one. The page is titled Etrian Odyssey Nexus, not Untold.

packs.name: Etrian Odyssey Nexus HD (v2)
packs.title: Etrian Odyssey Nexus
packs.author: Furizu
packs.notes: A 4x upscale of all the game's textures, with the PlayStation button layout, covering everything up to the 13th labyrinth. It is a four-part RAR of about 3.1 GB that must be fetched in order. Leave Preload Custom Textures off, as the author warns it will load everything and take very long.

packs.name: Shadow Lugia
packs.title: Pokémon Sun / Moon / Ultra Sun / Ultra Moon
packs.author: Butter_Lettuce
packs.notes: Recolours Lugia as Shadow Lugia with six replacement textures. The zip also holds a model file for the game's data archive, which is not installed because it needs a manual tool. It was made for the Generation 7 games.

packs.name: Modern Pokémon Sprites
packs.title: Pokémon Ultra Sun / Pokémon Ultra Moon
packs.author: stingflyer
packs.notes: Replaces every Pokémon sprite, including variants and Megas, with modern art at 8x resolution, about 1,000 textures. It does not cover Poké Pelago. Turn off texture filtering, which the author warns can break the sprites; it is tested on Azahar only.

packs.name: Faithful HD Pokémon Types
packs.title: Pokémon Ultra Sun / Pokémon Ultra Moon
packs.author: MetalTxus
packs.notes: One replacement texture that redraws the type icons at 5x size on a 5-pixel grid, so they scale cleanly. It changes nothing else.

packs.name: Faithful HD Fonts and UI (WIP)
packs.title: Pokémon Ultra Sun / Pokémon Ultra Moon
packs.author: Motorblade
packs.notes: A work in progress that upscales the fonts and some UI by 4x, covering English text, most Japanese characters, the cursor, most Poké Ball and Z-Crystal icons and some battle UI. It is made by hand without AI, and much is still unfinished.

packs.name: ACNL 4K TrueShade
packs.title: Animal Crossing: New Leaf
packs.author: ThisStombi
packs.notes: A 4K texture pack that gives the game more realistic lighting while keeping its cozy style. It needs an internal resolution of at least 8x, and about 20 villagers are not upscaled. The author recommends game version 1.0 to 1.3 rather than 1.4.

packs.name: Dunban's Scar Removed
packs.title: Xenoblade Chronicles 3D
packs.author: wexiyeb618
packs.notes: Removes the scar from Dunban's face on every armour set that shows it, with five replacement textures. It is a tiny pack. The page names no region.

packs.name: HD Title Screen
packs.title: Xenoblade Chronicles 3D
packs.author: Miguel92398
packs.licence: Free to use with credit and a link to the page
packs.notes: Replaces the title screen artwork with a high-definition version taken from the XBCHD texture pack, using 23 textures. It was made for the USA version, and the author says it was meant for Citra.

packs.name: HD Samus
packs.title: Metroid: Samus Returns
packs.author: HugAMuffin
packs.notes: Upscaled textures for Samus's Power, Varia and Gravity suits and the arm cannon, with extra hand-drawn detail that an upscaler would miss. It was made for Citra with the USA title ID. Its Gravity Suit textures clash with the separate HD Gravity Suit pack.

packs.name: HD Gravity Suit
packs.title: Metroid: Samus Returns
packs.author: sabre230
packs.notes: Hand-drawn textures for the Gravity Suit, based on the original concept art. It changes only the suit itself, not the arm cannon or morph ball. The textures sit in the USA title ID folder.

packs.name: Definitive Character Textures
packs.title: Sonic Generations
packs.author: Sonic Beyond
packs.notes: Retextures Classic Sonic, Modern Sonic and Tails to match their HD Generations looks, with seven textures. It is a small pack and the page names no region.

packs.name: HD Textures
packs.title: Sonic Generations
packs.author: pancharubin
packs.notes: Upscales the levels, characters and artwork, 1,744 textures in all. The download is large (836 MB), and the page names no region.

packs.name: Upscaled HD
packs.title: YO-KAI WATCH 2: Psychic Specters
packs.author: UH06
packs.notes: Waifu2x-upscaled textures for Psychic Specters, the version 2 pack with 2,789 textures for the UI and more areas. It may not look right at 3x native resolution or lower, and it does not work with linear texture filtering. The download is 646 MB.

packs.name: Redefined
packs.title: YO-KAI WATCH 3
packs.author: hotcapa
packs.notes: Retouches the backgrounds, menus and some scenery textures to be cleaner and more detailed while keeping the original style (99 large textures). The author says it is a beta and works only on the Spanish version of the game; the folder is named for title ID 1D6C00, which is not in the usual lists, so the USA ID is listed as well but not confirmed. The page is in Spanish and the download is 367 MB.

packs.name: End Layer HD Texture Pack
packs.title: Bravely Second: End Layer
packs.author: microturing
packs.notes: HD textures for characters, monsters, skills, the interface and many areas, about 2,800 textures. The author says it is unfinished and may need switching off in some areas to avoid crashes. The download is five 1 GB parts (4.7 GB in all) and the page warns about extraction errors; the folder is named for the USA title ID.

packs.name: HD
packs.title: Shin Megami Tensei IV
packs.author: AspenVesper
packs.notes: A hand-redrawn HD overhaul of 1,583 textures: fonts, UI, character and demon portraits and backgrounds, with some AI upscaling and full DLC support. Cutscenes and 3D textures are not covered. The PlayStation button add-ons on the page are not installed, and the download is 681 MB.

packs.name: Persona 5 X Demon Portraits
packs.title: Shin Megami Tensei IV
packs.author: Pascali
packs.notes: Swaps 113 demon portraits (223 counting bosses and conversations) for the ones from Persona 5: The Phantom X. It can be combined with an HD texture pack if you let this one replace the portrait files. The download is 206 MB.

packs.name: Dark Goth Nanashi Portrait
packs.title: Shin Megami Tensei IV: Apocalypse
packs.author: PointBlankVT
packs.notes: Draws the Dark Goth outfit onto Nanashi's portrait and small icon, at the default resolution. The HD version on the page is not installed. It goes well with the She/Her text mod.

packs.name: HD Edition
packs.title: Metal Gear Solid: Snake Eater 3D
packs.author: HugAMuffin
packs.notes: A hand-made HD overhaul of every area, with over 4,000 textures based on the HD Collection and some careful upscaling. It includes the author's HD NPCs, equipment, camo, animals and Snake mods. The download is 904 MB, and the author recommends Citra Canary or later.

packs.name: HD Edition (Jimlafleur)
packs.title: Metal Gear Solid: Snake Eater 3D
packs.author: Jimlafleur89
packs.notes: An incremental HD texture pack, currently the Virtuous Mission, with 162 textures made with 4K screens in mind. The author says more will follow, and the folder is named for the Europe title ID. It comes as two archives (a rar and a zip, about 570 MB together) that both go into the same texture folder.

packs.name: Show Some Skin
packs.title: Metal Gear Solid: Snake Eater 3D
packs.author: HugAMuffin
packs.notes: Gives Snake bare forearms and fingerless gloves, in the Virtuous Mission and the main game, with four textures. This is version 1.1; version 1.2 and a compatibility patch need the author's Haircut mod and are not installed. It does not affect the camo index and the author says it is for Citra.

packs.name: No Gyro Balance Icons
packs.title: Metal Gear Solid: Snake Eater 3D
packs.author: HugAMuffin
packs.notes: Removes the gyro control icon from the balance screens, since Citra and Azahar do not use gyro controls there. It is seven small textures. The author made it for Citra.

packs.name: Subtle Button Prompts
packs.title: Metal Gear Solid: Snake Eater 3D
packs.author: HugAMuffin
packs.notes: Makes the on-screen button prompts semi-transparent so they are less intrusive without being removed, with 30 small textures at 80% transparency. It is a tiny download, and the author made it for Citra.

packs.name: Combined HD Pack: UI
packs.title: Fire Emblem Fates (USA)
packs.author: Zoran501
packs.notes: Redrawn menus, text boxes, skill icons and the like. One part of the Combined HD Pack, made for the USA version.

packs.name: Combined HD Pack: Fonts
packs.title: Fire Emblem Fates (USA)
packs.author: Zoran501
packs.notes: Redrawn fonts. One part of the Combined HD Pack, made for the USA version.

packs.name: Combined HD Pack: Character Artwork
packs.title: Fire Emblem Fates (USA)
packs.author: Zoran501
packs.notes: HD character artwork, including the amiibo characters. One part of the Combined HD Pack, made for the USA version.

packs.name: Combined HD Pack: Face and Alpha Textures
packs.title: Fire Emblem Fates (USA)
packs.author: Zoran501
packs.folder: Fates HD Face and Alpha Textures
packs.notes: HD faces and alpha textures. One part of the Combined HD Pack, made for the USA version.

packs.name: Combined HD Pack: Map Floors
packs.title: Fire Emblem Fates (USA)
packs.author: Zoran501
